signal.reasoning: I can understand the economics shown here: Apple earns substantial free cash, holds gross margins near 49%, and has grown revenue while increasing book value per share. I would be comfortable examining this as a ten-year holding, but at 37.5 times earnings, the price leaves too little margin of safety for me to call it a buy.
